root_runtime_lease: One unit on emulator-5556 after Root explicitly returned it; no other device
observation: Always SDK preserve_accessibility_services=True for app trees; screenshots/video for system Settings and TalkBack overlays; no CLI dump or MixedInput
public_changes_allowed: Speech display checkbox through public TalkBack settings while reader is disabled
Use TalkBack toggle and required standard confirmation through public Settings
Public UI navigation necessary for that setup; no promise of opaque tutorial byte identity
preflight: Revalidate installed app, test and helper bytes plus compiled manifests
Capture public settings, reader/service state, display, locale, font, rotation and IME
Confirm reader initially disabled and record Speech display state before changing it
Prepare paused existing app without fixture/import/SystemOpen/install/build
reader_actions: Two single-finger right swipes with distinct app accessibility focus and corresponding actual reader speech
At most 30 further observed swipes to the canonical Project tools control
Exactly one double-tap at an observed neutral app point outside the focused button, requiring actual menu appearance and reader speech
transport: Public input touchscreen swipe/tap requests; exit zero alone proves no reader processing. Observe every action before the next. A failed gesture ends the case; no retap, direct control tap, setText, performAction or transport fallback.
evidence: Continuous video containing the TalkBack speech display
Complete app snapshots and metadata from the non-suppressing SDK observer
Actual focused node labels and bounds correlated with speech and menu
Every input request and host timestamps
Screenshots of every changed public control before and after
Installed APK hashes before and after
restoration: Restore TalkBack and Speech display to recorded public values
Restore every other public control actually changed and disclose any unplanned setting request
Confirm service state and settings; return the lane explicitly
Do not claim opaque internal preferences or tutorial state are byte-identical
fail_stop: Missing preflight identity or wrong artifact
Gesture not observed in focus and speech
No Tools menu after the one neutral double-tap
not_qualified: Physical touchscreen or hardware reader behavior
Audio quality if only speech display is retained
